definitions.explanation: Strong criticism directed at someone's actions, decisions, or behavior, typically on moral or ethical grounds. Stronger and more accusatory than {批判|ひはん}, implying that the target has done something wrong.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}の{対応|たいおう}が{非難|ひなん}された。
{彼|かれ}の{無責任|むせきにん}な{発言|はつげん}は{世間|せけん}から{非難|ひなん}を{浴|あ}びた。
examples.english: His irresponsible remarks drew public censure.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}{破壊|はかい}を{続|つづ}ける{企業|きぎょう}に{対|たい}して、{国際社会|こくさいしゃかい}から{厳|きび}しい{非難|ひなん}の{声|こえ}が{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: Harsh criticism from the international community is being directed at companies that continue to destroy the environment.

notes:
USAGE:
{非難|ひなん} implies moral or ethical fault-finding and is stronger than {批判|ひはん}, which can be more analytical or constructive. {非難|ひなん} suggests the speaker believes the target has done something wrong.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非難|ひなん}を{浴|あ}びる (to be showered with criticism)
- {非難|ひなん}の{声|こえ} (voices of criticism)
- {非難|ひなん}する (to criticize, to condemn)
- {非難|ひなん}を{受|う}ける (to receive criticism)
- {厳|きび}しい{非難|ひなん} (harsh criticism)
- {非難|ひなん}{合戦|がっせん} (war of words; exchange of accusations)

CAUTION:
Do not confuse with {避難|ひなん} (evacuation), which has the same reading but completely different meaning and kanji.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {非難|ひなん}: criticism, censure (moral fault-finding; accusatory)
- {批判|ひはん}: criticism (can be analytical or constructive)
- {糾弾|きゅうだん}: denunciation (even stronger; formal accusation)
- {避難|ひなん}: evacuation (different word, same reading)
